title: Strategy Review Output
description: Output contract for strategy agents when reviewing planner outputs. This schema generalizes docs/schemas/test-strategy-review.schema.json to serve as the canonical format for all strategy-to-planner review loops, extending the existing pattern (same status values, same conditional structure) while adding fields specific to general plan review (id, location, suggestion). This structured data appears after a review marker (e.g., REVIEW:) when evaluating a plan document against a strategy document.

status.description: The review status. APPROVED: plan aligns with strategy; FEEDBACK: plan needs improvements; BLOCKED: cannot review (e.g., missing required inputs).

issues.description: List of issues found during review. Required when status is 'FEEDBACK'.

reason.description: Explanation for why the review is blocked. Required when status is 'BLOCKED'.

allOf.description: When APPROVED, issues must be omitted or empty array. This structurally enforces 'no feedback remaining'.
When FEEDBACK, issues array is required with at least one issue.
When BLOCKED, reason is required explaining why review cannot proceed.

Issue.description: An issue identified during strategy review of a plan.

id.description: Unique identifier for tracking this issue across iterations (e.g., 'SR-1-001').

description.description: Detailed description of what is wrong.

location.description: Reference to the plan section where the issue occurs (e.g., 'Plan 3: Step 2', 'Overview section').

severity.description: Severity level of the issue. High: blocks plan approval; Medium: should be addressed; Low: nice to have.

suggestion.description: Actionable guidance on how to fix the issue.

issues.description: Plan does not address error handling for network failures
issues.suggestion: Add a step to implement retry logic with exponential backoff for network requests

issues.description: Schema definition lacks field validation rules
issues.suggestion: Specify regex patterns for string fields and min/max constraints for numeric fields

issues.description: Success criteria are vague and not measurable
issues.suggestion: Define specific, testable acceptance criteria (e.g., 'All unit tests pass with >90% coverage')

examples.reason: Cannot review - strategy document path is invalid or file does not exist
